title: I joined the IndieWeb, here's what I learned
summary: The author shares their experience joining the IndieWeb movement, a community of personal website owners using open web standards like WebMention, Micropub, and IndieAuth to own their content and interact with other sites directly without relying on centralized social platforms.
problem_solved: Decentralizing online identity and content ownership away from big social media platforms.
why_valuable: It demonstrates a practical approach to reclaiming web autonomy while maintaining interoperability with the broader internet through open standards.
